recognize_zh: 低倍下骨髓抽吸抹片在紅血球背景中出現一條緻密、互相黏著的深紫色細胞帶，由小圓形細胞組成並夾有淡藍色纖維狀基質，這種黏著性非造血細胞團提示轉移性腫瘤（神經母細胞瘤）。
features: Low-power field with a dense, elongated band of cohesive small round cells
Uniform cells with high N:C ratio and dark nuclei; detail limited at this magnification
Faint pale blue fibrillary matrix within the aggregate
Background of abundant red cells with sparse dispersed nucleated cells
describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large, dense, cohesive aggregate of small round cells streaked across the slide, set against a blood-rich background with few dispersed hematopoietic cells. The clustered cells appear monotonous with high N:C ratios, and a faint pale blue fibrillary matrix is seen within the aggregate. Nuclear and cytoplasmic detail cannot be fully assessed at this magnification. Findings are suggestive of metastatic small round cell tumor, consistent with metastatic neuroblastoma in the appropriate clinical context.

ddx.vs: A normal particle contains a heterogeneous mix of maturing myeloid, erythroid cells, megakaryocytes and fat rather than a monotonous cohesive cell population.
Blasts are dispersed singly throughout the smear rather than forming cohesive clumps.

ddx.dx: Other metastatic small round blue cell tumors (Ewing sarcoma, rhabdomyosarcoma)
ddx.vs: These also form clumps and require immunophenotyping (CD99/NKX2.2, myogenin) because low-power morphology cannot separate them.
